events.description: Called with an item's id when it is pressed; without it the rows are not pressable.
events.name: onItemPress

events.description: Called with an item's id when it is dismissed (its close button, or a swipe on native); without it there is none.
events.name: onDismiss

events.description: Called by the mark-all-read button, which shows only with it and while something is unread.
events.name: onMarkAllRead

events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

props.description: The notifications, newest first; the unread count on the bell is counted from them.
props.name: items

props.description: The bell's accessible name; defaults to "Notifications" with the unread count.
props.name: label

props.description: What an empty panel shows; defaults to "You're all caught up".
props.name: emptyState

props.description: Content under the list, such as a "View all" link.
props.name: footer

props.description:
Shows the inbox in place, as a card under its heading, for a notifications page or a dashboard tile: no bell, no
popover or drawer, and the open state is ignored. Defaults to `false`.
props.name: isInline

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen

events.description: Called with the item id when the row is pressed.
events.name: onPress

events.description: Called with the item id when it is dismissed.
events.name: onDismiss

props.description: The accessible name of the dismiss button.
props.name: dismissLabel

props.description: The spoken word for an unread item.
props.name: unreadLabel
